consumed_protected_evidence: 2024 protected selection (not used for Stage 8 tuning or selection)
post_selection_refit_history: 2022-2023 development + 2024 post-selection refit history available chronologically before each target cutoff
top20_recall_definition: intersection(nlargest(round(0.20 * n), actual), nlargest(round(0.20 * n), predicted)) / round(0.20 * n)
winner_loser_gap_definition: mean(winner_team_player_points) - mean(loser_team_player_points) across all evaluated periods
